module: Stamped decals as a site carries them: traffic arrows, painted EXIT text, asphalt repair patches. They are glyphs taken from a sheet (atlas) and placed at a point, oriented in a direction, and not paint traced along a line (which is what distinguishes them from siteMarks). The module creates the DecalData (templates), places the instances via the editor, converts them to/from the manifest format and makes them persistent.
notes: A decal record (plan): { mat, rows, cols, prio, tplSize (template size), x, y, a (angle in radians), size, frame (atlas cell), lift (elevation in m) }.
The templates are named "SiteDecal_<tag>_<n>" per site, because burning a site makes its own templates persistent and must not do the same for a neighbor's.
localise rounds the coordinates to the millimeter and writes the orientation as an angle, so that rotating the site is one addition per decal.

The instances are created by editor.addDecalInstanceWithTan with the normal pointing up, the terrain z obtained by terrainZ(x, y) + lift. The last two arguments of the call (3, 1) are constants in the code.
The decals are removed by editor.deleteDecalInstance; commit marks the templates "dirty" in decalPersistMan so that they survive the level save.

template.desc: Gets or creates the DecalData of a decal group, named after the site that stands it up. Fields set: material, frame, texRows, texCols, size, renderPriority (default 5).

spec.desc: { mat, frame, rows, cols, size, prio }.

returns.desc: DecalData object, or nil if creation fails.

emit.desc: Places a decal from its record: position (x, y) at terrain height plus lift, normal pointing up, tangent directed according to angle a.

rec.desc: { x, y, a, size, frame, lift }.

terrainZ.desc: terrainZ(x, y) returns the terrain height.

localise.desc: Converts a decal plan to the manifest format, local to the bake origin (ox, oy). Grouped by template (same mat, rows, cols, prio). Returns nil if the plan is empty.

returns.desc: { tpls = { {mat, rows, cols, prio, size}, ... }, items = { {t, x, y, a, size, frame, lift}, ... } }.

place.desc: The inverse of localise: the manifest's decals as a plan, placed where a placement is and rotated to its heading. (ox, oy) is the point of the site's frame around which the placement rotates.

ox.desc: x of the pivot in the site's frame (default 0).

returns.desc: Decal plan in world coordinates, or nil if empty.

build.desc: Stamps a whole plan at once, creating the required templates. tag distinguishes these templates from those of other sites. Returns the instances and the template identifiers, two things to clean up differently: an instance goes with the site, a template is shared by all the site's decals.

terrainZ.desc: terrainZ(x, y) returns the terrain height.

returns.desc: Identifiers of the DecalData templates created.

commit.desc: Gives the templates to the level, which makes the decals placed from them survive the save: the persistence manager keeps the instances against their template, so marking the few templates "dirty" writes all the decals. No effect if decalPersistMan does not exist.

facing.desc: Heading angle of a decal (atan2(ty, tx)) from the direction vector a builder already has.
